why: UA1C4/10 Student Government Association Photos - the WKU Archives' own SGA photograph collection, described as 'Images of Student Government Association members and activities at Western Kentucky University'. The record page reads fine over plain HTTP; the finding aid PDF behind it (context/dlsc_ua_fin_aid/article/1619/viewcontent/auto_convert.pdf) is the only thing that lists what is actually in the collection, and that file 403s like every other TopSCHOLAR download. This is the single most relevant unread document in the archive for the whole portrait project, not just one block: an item-level inventory of SGA photographs would give dates, subjects and names for decades that no other source covers, and 2004-2011 in particular has no Talisman at all.
note: READ, 30 September 2026, via the web.archive.org id_ bypass (the redirect chain lands on cgi/viewcontent.cgi?params=...&path_info=auto_convert.pdf, a different query shape than the article=/context= form most other TopSCHOLAR downloads use; only 178 KB, 5 pages). It is exactly what it claims: a physical-collection finding aid listing folders (F334, F247, F320, F322, F323, F4167-F4170) by date range and the names appearing in each folder's prints, 1961-1991. It names no SGA figure this archive does not already have from other sources for that span, and - critically - it is an inventory of un-digitised prints in physical folders, not a source of any image file: nothing behind it can actually be fetched. Useful as a future lead list for names it turns up that a Herald or Talisman search hasn't already covered (Doug Alexander, Brett Butler, Marshall Galloway, Joe Gerard, Carol Gray, John Lyne, David Porter, Georganna Sleamker, Tom Tabor, Sally Webb, Larry Zielke, 1962-73; Jack Britt, Judson Jenkins, Bryan Lowe, Neal Markham, Albert Shelby, Kelly Sutherland, Pattye Thomason, 1990-91; the full 1968-69 election and inauguration rosters already named in CLAUDE.md's Reed Morgan note), but closed as a photograph source.
